anchors.paper_title: Motor Control Processes Moderate Visual Working Memory Gating
anchors.reason: The dataset README says it accompanies this exact J Neurosci paper, with matching title, authors, and task. It also asks users to cite the paper, and it holds the raw EEG from the study.

metadata.methods_description: Participants performed a delayed color-reproduction task in a 2x2 within-subject design (same-hand or different-hand, motor or visuomotor interference) plus 240 baseline trials, across 10 blocks of 120 trials. A colored square or diamond target was shown for 500 ms, followed by a 2900 ms delay, and then participants reported the target color on a color wheel using a left or right knob. In two-thirds of trials, a left- or right-pointing triangle appeared at 900 ms during the delay and required a knob press. The triangles were gray in the motor condition and colored in the visuomotor condition. EEG was recorded throughout, and behavioral data are stored in EEG.behaviordata.

citation_details.title: LaBraM at Scale: Scaling Data and Models for EEG Pretraining
citation_details.author: Junyu Pan, Ruicheng Yin, Bao‐Liang Lu, Dongsheng Li, Wei-Long Zheng, Yansen Wang
citation_details.abstract: LaBraM, an early EEG foundation model, demonstrated that large-scale EEG pretraining can yield strong representations for diverse downstream tasks. Building on this foundation, we expand pretraining data and model capacity while retaining its core encoder and objective. We train ten encoders with 5.8 million to 1.97 billion parameters on three EEG collections spanning 25,067 to 79,910 hours, adapting signal preparation and training to heterogeneous recordings. Across 23 tasks, Atom-L* reaches 59.05% mean balanced accuracy at its best evaluated full fine-tuning (Full-FT) checkpoint, 3.61 percentage points above the strongest baseline EEG foundation model. Quark-G leads linear probing (LP) at 54.33%, a 1.24-point margin. Both also lead average task rank. At the last evaluated checkpoints, larger encoders improve Full-FT more consistently than LP, and stronger LP does not guarantee stronger Full-FT.
